name: What factors affect the cost of interior remodel painting?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of interior remodel painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodel painting costs depend primarily on wall square footage, surface condition, ceiling heights, and detail work like doors and moldings. Rooms requiring extensive drywall patching, water stain sealing, or heavy texture matching require more labor hours before paint application begins. Upgrading from basic wall-only painting to detailed trim packages, built-in shelving, or multi-color accent schemes also adds time and materials. A detailed walk-through allows the contractor to assess prep requirements and provide an accurate scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on room square footage, ceiling heights, required drywall repairs or texturing, and whether doors, baseboards, and moldings are included in the scope.
